root_cause: The pre-spend gate only checked output format (9:16, mute, 1080p). Veo 3.1 had already failed the independent face gate on real paid runs (0.900 on 2026-11-03 history 6GYKFxqd9aif8WacnMnL and again on 2026-11-07 history B5uX1JhoC8hl0kiFTrnl, 280 credits) but the recorded failures never influenced admission, so the same model was paid for again.
prevention: assessMiraProviderBeforeSpend now consults MIRA_MODEL_FACE_EVIDENCE. A model/mode whose best measured face score is below 0.940 returns MIRA_MODEL_FACE_GATE_FAILED_BEFORE and generation_preflight answers 422. There is no caller-supplied bypass; re-enabling needs a reviewed source change with new measured evidence. Thresholds, budget and publisher are unchanged.
